title: Home Mortgage Loans: Recasting the Payment After Principal Curtailments
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Recasting the Payment After Principal Curtailments

A recast lets a borrower with Home Mortgage Loans turn a large paydown of principal into a smaller monthly payment. The note rate and the maturity date stay as they were; only the principal-and-interest payment is recalculated.

## What a recast does

The remaining principal is re-amortized over the remaining term at the existing note rate. The monthly principal-and-interest payment falls as a result, while the rate and the maturity date do not change.

## Conditions

- **Program permits recasts.** A recast exists only in a program where recasts are offered. Loans in the FHA, VA and adjustable-rate programs cannot be recast. Borrowers in those programs may still send curtailments; there, a curtailment shortens the loan rather than lowering the payment.
- **Enough curtailment.** The curtailments made since the last recast must add up to at least the program's curtailment total for a recast.
- **Loan standing.** The loan must be active and current.

## How the curtailment total is measured

The total is the sum of the principal portions of every payment posted as a curtailment, counted from the date of the loan's last recast, or from the funding date if the loan has never been recast, up to today. The figures come from the loan's transaction records.

## The fee

Each recast carries the program's recast fee. The fee is assessed on the loan, recorded as a recast fee, and becomes part of the fees due.

## Positive and negative cases (hypothetical figures)

The programs, amounts and minimum below are invented; each real program publishes its own curtailment total and fee.

| Case | Program allows recasts | Curtailments since last recast | Imagined minimum | Loan active and current | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | yes | $9000.00 and $6500.00, total $15500.00 | $15000.00 | yes | every condition met |
| B | yes | total $15500.00 | $15000.00 | no, delinquent | not available |
| C | yes | $12000.00 after the last recast; an earlier $8000.00 before it | $15000.00 | yes | not available: only $12000.00 counts |
| D | no | total $40000.00 | not relevant | yes | not available; the curtailments shorten the loan |
